subject: Post-call sponsor recap — business outcomes, risks and procurement checkpoints for Medisync
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medisync.com>, Kevin Lee <kevin.lee@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call sponsor recap — business outcomes, risks and procurement checkpoints for Medisync

Hi Elena / Kevin — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment with your execs and procurement. TL;DR: Medisync is prioritizing a pilot that demonstrates predictable sub-250ms p95 inference for clinical triage flows, a clear cost per 1M tokens so your finance team can model ROI, and a deployment option that meets PHI controls (either Private / VPC or Dedicated with guaranteed isolation).

What we heard (pain / goals):
- Latency: current inference p95 > 500ms on critical triage path; this impacts throughput and clinician UX.
- Cost volatility: token costs spike due to bursty load; finance needs a predictable unit economics baseline.
- Data controls: PHI scope and retention policy are gating — security needs SOC 2 artifacts and KMS/HSM details.
- Timeline: desire to start a pilot before Q2 close; procurement wants a clear path and an estimated budget.

Proposed outcomes for the pilot (6 weeks):
1) Validate p95 < 250ms on representative traffic (we'll run with a shadow mirror of your triage endpoint).
2) Provide a cost baseline (sample invoices & token accounting) for FY28 budget modeling.
3) Deliver a security pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, KMS integration options).

Procurement & decision path we recommend:
- Week 0: NDA + high-level SOW review (we can provide a short SOW stub).
- Week 1–2: Security questionnaire and SOC 2 exchange; confirm network approach (VPC peering vs Private).
- Week 3: Pilot kickoff (engineer + solutions SE support).
- Week 6: Pilot readout and go/no-go — if positive, move to reserved capacity discussion / contract.

Open items we need from Medisync (please confirm):
- Primary procurement contact (name + email) — this will be the hub for contracts.
- Security reviewer contact to receive SOC 2 artifacts and the questionnaire.
- Budget band / ballpark price threshold for pilot so we can size capacity and provide a short-rate card.

Attachments: redwood-inference-pilot-plan.pdf (pilot scope + tasks).

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync next week? I can do Thu 3/30 09:00-11:00 PT or Fri 3/31 13:00-16:00 PT. If those don't work, suggest a time and I will send an invite.

Thanks — I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to prep the SOW and security artifacts.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Rachel — great summary, appreciate the clarity. Quick responses inline: 

- Procurement: looping Sarah Jensen (cc) — she will coordinate contracts and PO.
- Security: Kevin will own the SOC 2 exchange and the questionnaire; I'll introduce him to your SE if needed.
- Timeline: we are motivated to run a pilot but need a ballpark number for the pilot to present to finance. Can you provide a high-level range for a 6-week pilot (including engineer SE support)?

We also need an ROI one-pager for our CFO (shows cost vs expected reduction in manual triage time). I can share a template if you want.

Available next week: Thu 3/30 10:00–11:30 PT works for Sarah and Kevin. Please send an invite with objectives.

Thanks — Elena

elena.torres@medisync.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 07:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call sponsor recap — internal notes (Medisync)

Rachel / Ben — internal alignment before we respond publicly. Short points: 
1) Risk: PHI + retention policies could push this to Private deployment with HSM; that will materially affect timeline and legal. If Kevin's security team is strict we'll need to propose a fallback: Hosted (VPC peering) -> Dedicated (reserved) -> Private (on-prem/VPC) decision ladder.
2) Artifacts: prepare SOC 2 summary + ISMS overview and a short KMS/HSM options doc. Ben, please start a straw SOW that includes both Dedicated and Private options and clearly called-out migration economics.
3) Price guidance: for a small pilot (single model, limited traffic) expect ballpark $10k–$20k/month depending on model size and peak throughput; include a note that Private/HSM will increase setup fees.
4) Owners: Ben = SOW + pilot pricing; Rachel = procurement coordination; Marissa = security artifacts and escalation lead to solutions.

I'll draft the internal risk note for the account and attach to the HubSpot record. Send the SOW stub and security pack to Elena and Sarah as next step.

—Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medisync.com>, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@medisync.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: SOW & security pack (pilot options) — Medisync

Elena / Sarah — attaching the short SOW stub and a security brief to get the procurement and security review started. Files attached: medisync-sow-v1.pdf (pilot SOW, includes Dedicated and Private option sections), redwood-security-brief.zip (SOC 2 summary, network diagrams, KMS options).

Ballpark pricing for the 6-week pilot (final number depends on model family and requested concurrency):
- Hosted / Dedicated (no HSM): $12,000–$16,000 per month (pilot prorated to 6 weeks).
- Private deployment with HSM & onboarding: additional one-time setup fee $25,000–$40,000 plus higher monthly reserved capacity pricing.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm procurement attendee for Thu 3/30 10:00 PT — we will send calendar invite.
2) Sarah: if you can sign the attached short SOW + NDA we can lock the pilot window (we can issue a work order to start SE time).
3) Kevin / Marissa: we will share the SOC 2 artifacts and follow the security questionnaire rhythm; please let us know any mandatory controls we should map immediately.

If you're agreeable, we'll prepare a short ROI one-pager for your CFO (we have a template we can tailor).

Attachments (stubs):
- medisync-sow-v1.pdf (SOW stub)
- redwood-security-brief.zip (security artifacts)

Regards,
